title: Trumbauer, Eddie Lang and Bix
summary: Barbarin liked Trumbauer's band, did not know Lang or Bix by name.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Before we do that, I wanted to ask you about Trumbauer. Did you ever listen to his records much? One time we were talking about it.
Yeah, I liked the band. I liked, I think they made Singin' the Blues. Yeah, yeah. I liked their band. Very good band.
Did you know Eddie Lang, the guitar player?
No, I knew the other big guy that died, he was a wonderful guitar man. Great big fella. I can't think of his name. He was very popular in the 20s. Can't recall the guy's name.
Well don't worry about it. I just wondered if you knew Bix and...
No, I never met Bix, no. I never met Bix, no.
Well I'm sure you knew each other but not by name. Yeah, maybe so, yeah.
